items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Joe Bishop, of course, did a masterful job of writing tunes for the band, writing arrangements for the band, and then switching over from tuba, which he played with Isham, to flugelhorn with our band.

ctx.x: And -- however, it gave me a chance to prove what I wanted to do somewhat musically, and with -- my first actual recording dates were with the Isham Jones band. I did some earlier with Tom Garen's band, but they were once again entertainment quality records. And this was my first -- little more musical experience, and eventually we had -- our first jazz date was done as a small group, and we were the Isham Jones Juniors. And it was really my group, along with the rhythm section and maybe a trumpet, and Joe Bishop…
